Lubos na Urbanisadong Lungsod (Highly Urbanized City, HUC)

facts.note_fil: Makikita ang moto sa opisyal na letterhead ng lungsod (PDF ng EO PCG-16 s.2022).
facts.note_en: Motto appears on official city letterhead (EO PCG-16 s.2022 PDF).

facts.value_fil: Batas Republika Blg. 7829, inaprubahan noong Disyembre 8, 1994, na nagpalit sa Munisipalidad ng Pasig bilang highly urbanized city na tinatawag na Lungsod ng Pasig
facts.value_en: Republic Act No. 7829, approved December 8, 1994, converting the Municipality of Pasig into a highly urbanized city to be known as the City of Pasig

facts.value_fil: Ipinagdiriwang tuwing Hulyo 2 ang pagkakatatag ng poblacion ng Pasig sa kasalukuyan nitong lokasyon noong 1573
facts.value_en: Celebrated every July 2: the founding of Pasig's poblacion at its present location in 1573

facts.value_fil: Immaculate Conception; Pista ng Bayan prusisyon tuwing Disyembre 8, pinangungunahan ng Immaculate Conception Cathedral ng Pasig
facts.value_en: Immaculate Conception; the Pista ng Bayan procession is held on December 8, led by the Immaculate Conception Cathedral of Pasig

facts.value_fil: Noong Marso 2025, isinasagawa na ang demolition ng lumang City Hall complex sa Caruncho Ave., Brgy. San Nicolas para magbigay-daan sa Bagong City Hall. Pansamantalang huminto noong Marso 20, 2025 ang PSA CRS Outlet doon dahil dito
facts.value_en: As of March 2025, the old City Hall complex on Caruncho Ave., Brgy. San Nicolas was being demolished to make way for the New City Hall. The PSA CRS Outlet there stopped operating on March 20, 2025 because of this

contact.city_hall_address: Pasig City Temporary City Hall, Eulogio Amang Rodriguez Avenue, Bridgetowne, Barangay Rosario, Pasig City (some offices began moving in on September 16, 2024, while the New City Hall is built at the Caruncho Ave., Brgy. San Nicolas site)
contact.trunkline_note: The Pasig City Hall trunkline (8643 1111) was announced as operational on April 14, 2024. A 2023 Manila Bulletin item gives the older form '(02) 643-1111 loc. 1162' for PDAO.
